posts.author: Blitz_Burgh@sportsbots.xyz
posts.text: Cam Heyward looks forward to the Browns game on Sunday: “I know they've gotten on a roll. You know, they beat us. They beat Baltimore as well. You watch them win their game last week versus Tennessee, and they've really found their footing. Everybody likes to talk about Myles Garrett and all, but that does not matter with this team—this team has come to play. Deshaun Watson is playing very well. Harold Fannin, Quinshon Judkins, and then their defense—I think they're electric. I have a lot of respect for those guys. I'm looking forward to this game. These are the types of games you want. It's a five-star matchup because we're in it, as Mike T. would say.” #Steelers #NFL

posts.author: Blitz_Burgh@sportsbots.xyz
posts.text: Cam Heyward opens up about Aaron Rodgers: “Aaron prepares as soon as that game's done onto the next game. And we feel it throughout the week. He's asking the right questions. He's always challenging players. He's always making sure the offense feels like it's up to speed. And so when he's checking plays and he's making sure everybody's accountable, you feel as comfortable as you can. You feel like he's gonna lead you to the right destination, just because he is prepared. He is a student of the game. A lot of times we talk about being a teacher to the young guys, but he's always trying to find things that are nuanced and that work. And when you got a guy that can still throw as fast as he does and throw as long as he does, he's gonna put you in the right direction.” #Steelers #NFL

posts.author: Blitz_Burgh@sportsbots.xyz
posts.text: Todd Haley details on 93.7 The Fan how the Steelers can win playoff games: “What has to happen in my view for the Steelers if we're talking winning playoff games is they have to make plays on the outside. I told you guys this a few weeks ago. I mean, they made the scramble play to DK—great play by him, great throw by Aaron using his feet. But I think that's the key. I loved running the football on all those third-and-shorts. That was awesome. Those are backbreakers for the defense. When you're converting a third-and-four or five running the football, those are killers. But who is this outside guy that can make those plays when teams say, 'Hey, we're not going to allow you to run it'? We saw it two nights ago with Seattle. They said, 'We're not going to let Kenneth Walker beat us.' And all of a sudden, Kansas City got exposed a little bit because there was nobody on the outside winning. And that's my biggest concern with the Steelers right now.” #Steelers #NFL

X-Rays were negative, and he has an MRI today. But high-ankle sprains are often 4-6 week injuries

Panthers Pro Bowl CB Jaycee Horn is out indefinitely after suffering a quad injury in Sunday’s loss to the Browns, sources tell The Ringer and Netflix Sports.

Horn is seeking a second opinion. But he’s likely to land on injured reserve and miss significant time.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text:
Bucs QB Baker Mayfield underwent tests that showed no fracture and no tendon or ligament damage in his right thumb, sources tell The Ringer and Netflix Sports. 

Mayfield will need to regain strength after Sunday’s dislocation and likely will miss some time. But good news overall.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text:
By trading J.J. McCarthy now, the Vikings save over $4.6M in cash and cap space and get an unconditional fifth-round pick in the next draft that, depending how the Giants finish, could end up being a top-150 selection.

Meanwhile, New York adds another former first-round pick QB.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text:
Trade! The Vikings are sending QB J.J. McCarthy to the Giants for a 2027 fifth-round pick, sources tell The Ringer and Netflix Sports.

With Jaxson Dart out for the regular season, New York adds another young QB, while Minnesota gains flexibility and McCarthy gets a fresh start.
